page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head top centre, page number top left. Below the text: date, signature lines and the printed name block, right-aligned. Then a letter heading "EPIS T. LXIII." with superscription and indented first lines. Catchword bottom right.

main_text.p: varum opinionum spinis ita implicant, ut id unum eos agere dicas, qvi cum adversariis Ecclesiæ paria facere videntur: proinde officium, & diligentiam tuam probo, qvod de ejus generis libro nos præmonere volueris, qvem inter Abrahami Ecchellensis sarcinas adhuc delite-scentem, videre nec dum licuit; interim de remedio opportuno cogitare licebit, qvod mature curabitur, utinam eo effe-ctu, ut istorum proterviam suprema Ecclesiæ autoritas compescat. Vale, vir Reverende, & de tuis studiis subinde ad nos scribe.
main_text.head: EPIS T. LXIII.
main_text.p: Johannes Morinus Cardinali Barberino. Libri Celloti prolixa eaqve paulo acri-or critice; qvi sit antiqvus & nupe-rus Curiæ Francicæ Stylus in iis, de qvibus agit Cellotus.

page.notes: Printed text has no marginal notes. Long s has been rendered as plain s throughout. The superscription is set in mixed roman and italic, as printed. The "Car-" catchword is at the foot right, below the last line.
